Hash-chain map templates with insert, remove, query, iteration, verify, and optional multi-key support.

# Purpose
This file defines a template for a hash-chain map that is generated by macros for a chosen element type and API prefix. It provides the core map operations for creation, join and leave of a formatted memory region, deletion, insertion, removal, query, iteration, and verification. The map stores elements in an external pool and keeps chain heads in the map object, so the same code can be used with different element layouts and with either index-based or pointer-based access. The file also exposes helper functions for key comparison and hashing, plus size and alignment queries for the map storage region.

The code supports several configuration options. `MAP_MULTI` enables multiple elements with the same key and adds functions to walk to the next matching element. `MAP_OPTIMIZE_RANDOM_ACCESS_REMOVAL` adds reverse links in elements so removal by known index can run in O(1) time. The implementation is designed for use in shared memory and other persistent or inter-process settings, so it uses a magic value, alignment checks, and explicit `new`, `join`, `leave`, and `delete` operations. The file can act as a header-only interface or as an implementation unit, depending on `MAP_IMPL_STYLE`.
